# dsh-custom-splash

A startup-screen plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH):
play **your own video** full-screen while DSH bo
ots, then fade into the app.
中文详细说明：README.zh.md
## Features
- **Video mode (default)** — a local MP4 covering the window, auto-fading into the app when it ends.

- **Swap the video without reinstalling** — drop any MP4 at
`%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\startup-video\boot.

mp4` (or `~/.dsh/startup-video/boot.mp4`),
or point the setting at any absolute path (file or direct

ory).
- **No first-frame flash** — the lock class is added synchronously in `<head>` and the
black o

verlay is the first child of `<body>`, so the app never paints before the video.
- **Streams with HT

TP Range** — `/dsh-startup/media/<file>` supports `206`, `HEAD` and
seeking, and is served with `Cac

he-Control: no-store`.
- **Never hangs the boot** — autoplay rejection falls back to muted + an "unm

**Skippable** — bottom-right skip button, `Esc`, or click (after 0.9 s).
- **Per-session by default*

* — a refresh in the same tab does not replay it;
`always` / `daily` are also available.
> **Note**: The built-in six-act interactive sequence from the upstream project is currently disable
d in this v1.0.0 fork due to a DOM mounting compatibility issue. It will be restored in a future upd
this v1.0.0 fork due to a DOM mounting compatibility issue. It will be restored in a future update.

## Use your own video
Fastest path — overwrite one file:

If that file is missing the plugin falls back to its own `lib/assets/video/boot.mp4`,
so deleting it
never leaves you with a black screen.

Prefer another location? **Settings → Startup screen → Video absolute path** accepts a
file or a dir
ectory (relative paths are rejected). Leave it empty to use the bundled clip.

## Settings
**DSH Settings → "Startup screen"** (labels are in Chinese).

Playback: enabled · source (`video` / `builtin`) · video absolute path · video file name ·
fit (`cov
er` / `contain`) · muted · volume · mode (`session` / `always` / `daily`) · allow skip.

Builtin sequence only: theme · speed · require confirmation · identity name/id/clearance ·
voice (on

/off, source, voice, rate, pitch, volume, cue sound, intro delay) · UI sounds ·
accent and glitch co
lors · all copy fields.
The builtin-only fields are hidden automatically in video mode.
## FAQ

- **Nothing shows up** — check that the "Startup screen" section exists in Settings
(otherwise the b

undle is not mounted), that "Enabled" is on, and that mode is not
`session` with the tab already vis

ited. On Desktop, quit from the tray.
- **Video does not play** — verify H.264/yuv420p/AAC, or enabl

e "Muted" (muted autoplay is
exempt from browser autoplay policies). Failures release the page inste

ad of hanging it.
- **No sound** — browsers require a user gesture before audio; a muted fallback wi

th an
"unmute" button is provided.
- **401 from `/dsh-startup/*`** — expected: those routes only tru

st loopback requests
carrying the host's trust marker.
